fact: The Minister for Finance told Parliament on 14 February 2020 that the government core network equipment and security had been replaced and that in the 2020/21 financial year government would, with the assistance of development partners, extend networks to the Tinkhundla Service Centres and health facilities; it is a stated intention, with no centre said to be connected, no count and no budget figure.
title: Budget Speech 2020
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Kingdom of Eswatini
